name_reason: Already compliant: fd2_<descriptor> game-function naming, no address residue. 'party_roster_single_select_loop' accurately describes the function (a single-character party-roster grid selection loop) and the 'single' qualifier correctly distinguishes it from the sibling fd2_party_roster_class_select_loop (the class-filtered, stat-preview variant). Confirmed by the 5 callers (buy/sell/equip/give/status menus) all using it as a member picker.
purpose: Modal party-roster member-selection loop: opens a 2-column x 3-row party grid panel, runs the arrow/commit/cancel input loop, and returns whether the user committed or cancelled. Used to pick a character for the buy/sell/equip/give/status screens.
logic_summary: Setup: __CHK(0x18) stack probe; malloc three 64000-byte workspace buffers into data_fd2_ui_slide_anim_accumulator_buf_ptr / data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf_ptr / data_fd2_ui_slide_composed_target_buf_ptr; snapshot the live VGA framebuffer (0xA0000) into the bg-snapshot buffer and clone it into the composed-target buffer; reset scroll offset and cursor to 0; blit the panel header sprite (atlas entry at atlas[+0x46]) into composed_target+0x8C05; render the initial grid; then a 6-frame slide-down (frame 5..0, panel y = frame*0xD + 0x70). Input loop: poll fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink(3) (mode 3 = roster grid + cursor) and dispatch on the scancode. Right(0x4D): if cursor != count-1, chime, cursor+1, page up if cursor-scroll>5, re-render to 0xA0000. Left(0x4B): if cursor!=0, chime, cursor-1, page down if cursor<scroll, re-render. Up(0x48): if cursor>1, chime, cursor-2, then shared page-down/re-render tail. Down(0x50): if cursor<count-2, chime, cursor+2, then shared page-up/re-render tail. Enter(0x1C)/Space(0x39): result=1. Esc(0x01): result=-1. Loops while result==0. Buffer cleanup is the caller's responsibility via fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out (0x2D31B), the companion 'close' that frees the same 3 shared buffers.

returns.semantics: 1 = user committed (Enter 0x1C / Space 0x39); -1 = user cancelled (Esc 0x01). Callers treat 1 as 'selection made, proceed' and any non-1 (i.e. -1) as 'abort this branch'.
